mapper.select: SELECT id FROM disputes WHERE work_case_id = #{workCaseId} AND status IN ('OPEN', 'UNDER_REVIEW') FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO disputes (work_case_id, requester_id, dispute_type, title, content, status) VALUES (#{workCaseId}, #{requesterUserId}, 'WAGE', #{title}, #{content}, 'OPEN')
mapper.select: SELECT id AS disputeId, work_case_id AS workCaseId, title AS title, content AS content, status AS status FROM disputes WHERE id = #{disputeId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE disputes SET status = 'UNDER_REVIEW', updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE id = #{disputeId} AND status = 'OPEN'

UPDATE disputes SET status = #{targetStatus}, resolution = #{resolution}, resolved_by_user_id = NULL, resolved_at = NOW(6), updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE id = #{disputeId} AND status IN ('OPEN', 'UNDER_REVIEW') AND #{targetStatus} IN ('RESOLVED', 'REJECTED')
mapper.select: SELECT d.id AS reportId, d.title AS title, d.content AS content, d.status AS status, d.resolution AS resolution, CASE WHEN d.requester_id = wc.employer_id THEN 'OWNER' ELSE 'WORKER' END AS requesterRole, d.created_at AS createdAt, d.resolved_at AS resolvedAt, r.source AS reviewSource, r.decision AS reviewDecision, CAST(r.reason_codes AS CHAR) AS reviewReasonCodesJson, r.summary AS reviewSummary, r.confidence AS reviewConfidence, r.completed_at AS reviewedAt FROM disputes d JOIN work_cases wc ON wc.id = d.work_case_id LEFT JOIN dispute_ai_reviews r ON r.id = ( SELECT latest.id FROM dispute_ai_reviews latest WHERE latest.dispute_id = d.id AND latest.status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY latest.completed_at DESC, latest.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE d.work_case_id = #{workCaseId} ORDER BY d.created_at DESC, d.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
